adversary_breaks.expected: Per the package objective and AGENTS.md ('unknown/corrupt state never becomes ... successful deletion'): a deletion the worker refused to certify must not be reported as completed with a receipt through another surface. Either the durable row carries last_error_code=completion_unverified (so /delete-status reports it) or the receipt is withheld until the residue is cleared/inventoried by a service-side path. The candidate's own re-verification guards only the confirm/claim surface, not /delete-status.
adversary_breaks.observed: VERIFIED on 4d7ccb87 through the real Edge handler + real PostgREST v12.2.3 + disposable Postgres: after Apple revoke, RevenueCat delete and auth.users DELETE, the post-Auth sweep finds a player_rank_state row → POST /v1/me/delete-confirm answers 503 with no `deleted`/`completionReceipt`, logs completion_unverified/player_rank_state. But api_private.account_deletion_operations already reads phase=completed, completed_at set, lease_token=null, last_error_code=null (the auth.users AFTER DELETE trigger record_account_deletion_auth_absence() marks completed and clears the lease, so fail_account_deletion_operation() returns stale_lease and never records completion_unverified). GET /v1/me/delete-status (the capability the app polls after a 503) returns 200 state=completed with a completionReceipt; the owner's bearer now gets 401 so the sweep can never be re-run. AssertionError: worker withheld completion (residue in player_rank_state) but durable phase=completed last_error_code=null and /delete-status state=completed with a receipt

reasons: blocked: The r2 P1 (residue found after Auth deletion → confirm 503 without receipt, but api_private.account_deletion_operations already phase=completed with completed_at set and /delete-status hands out a receipt) is rooted in SQL owned by the `sql` serial group, which W08-06 does not hold: the auth.users AFTER DELETE trigger api_private.record_account_deletion_auth_absence() (supabase/migrations/20260907001500_account_deletion_operations.sql) seals completed_at/phase='completed' and clears lease_token in the same transaction as the identity delete, so public.fail_account_deletion_operation(…,'completion_unverified') returns stale_lease (api_private.lock_account_deletion_lease rejects auth_deleted_at is not null) and no other service-role RPC can record the verdict; the owner holds no DELETE grant on shots/consent_records/player_rank_state etc. (revoked in 20260831160000_defense_in_depth.sql), so the Edge cannot clear residue itself either. VERIFIED on the real wire (p1-e2e-candidate-baseSQL.log). No Edge-only change can make the durable row/`/delete-status` honest. The Edge half is implemented and verified: runClaimedDeletion() now (1) reads the receipt, (2) pages every owner namespace to empty AFTER the Auth delete, (3) throws residue → fail_account_deletion_operation(completion_unverified) with the lease binding, and (4) only when the sweep is empty and the durable row is not yet certified calls public.certify_account_deletion_completion(p_owner_id,p_operation_id,p_lease_token). On today's migrations that RPC does not exist; it is reached only when the trigger did NOT seal (intent not ready), where the PostgREST function-not-found error degrades to the same generic 503 the base code returned (`Account deletion completion is unverified.`) — verified: the full suite, the r2 clean-deletion/concurrency/redirect real-wire attacks (#1/#7/#8) and the live cascade test pass on the repo migrations. DEPENDENCY: a new sql-group migration (draft written, applied to a disposable DB and validated end to end, NOT committed — https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/b819cbcc-2b75-4286-acc8-4b85eea076d8/20260909120000_account_deletion_certified_completion.sql): the trigger records auth_deleted_at and KEEPS the worker's lease token when the intent was ready (still marks auth_absent_without_ready_intent and clears the lease otherwise); public.certify_account_deletion_completion(uuid,uuid,uuid) (service_role EXECUTE only) sets completed_at/phase under the same advisory lock only when Auth is absent with a ready intent and the lease token matches; fail_account_deletion_operation accepts completion_unverified post-Auth against the retained lease token. The status view already reads auth_deleted_at set + completed_at null as `blocked` with no receipt, and acquire answers `blocked`. With the draft: supabase/tests/security_regression.sql passes (exit 0), but supabase/tests/account_deletion_operations.sql:195-227 pins the old atomic-seal semantics ('W08 Auth transaction must see both cascade and completion receipt', 'real Auth deletion atomically seals durable receipt') and fails at line 206 (exit 3, https://la-hacks-rttothemoon.devinenterprise.com/attachments/68e9b96b-dfb1-49b1-bfcc-9979e9a0e1ab/sql-tests-account_deletion_operations-draftSQL.log) — those sql-group tests must be updated by the sql-group holder together with the migration (I may not edit supabase/tests/). Alternative smaller SQL design if the seal pin must stay: keep the trigger, let fail_(…,'completion_unverified') mark the sealed row and have account_deletion_view/read_account_deletion_receipt/claim_account_deletion_work treat completed_at+last_error_code='completion_unverified' as `blocked` without a receipt; the Edge code on this branch is compatible with either design.
